sights.address: Portsmouth Square, Chinatown, San Francisco, CA 94108
sights.w: 'Chinatown's living room' — the 1.5-acre plaza where Montgomery raised the US flag in 1846; mornings of tai chi and Chinese chess, with the Robert Louis Stevenson memorial and the Goddess of Democracy statue.
sights.k: Portsmouth Square Chinatown plaza tai chi history

sights.address: 916 Kearny St, San Francisco, CA 94133
sights.w: The copper-green 1907 flatiron at Columbus & Kearny that survived 1906 — later Coppola's American Zoetrope HQ (Café Zoetrope on the ground floor), framed against the Transamerica Pyramid.
sights.k: Columbus Tower Sentinel Building flatiron Zoetrope

sights.address: Pier 45, Fisherman's Wharf, San Francisco, CA 94133
sights.w: WWII Balao-class submarine (six Pacific patrols) moored at Pier 45 — one of the best-preserved fleet subs anywhere; squeeze through the torpedo rooms on a self-guided audio tour.
sights.k: USS Pampanito submarine Pier 45 museum ship

sights.address: The Embarcadero & Beach St (Pier 39), San Francisco, CA 94133
sights.w: The waterfront aquarium at Pier 39 devoted to San Francisco Bay's own waters — 300 ft of walk-through tunnels with sevengill sharks, bat rays and river otters.
sights.k: Aquarium of the Bay Pier 39 tunnels sharks

sights.address: Sutro Tower, Mount Sutro, San Francisco, CA 94131
sights.w: The 977-ft three-legged 'aviation orange' broadcast tower crowning Mount Sutro since 1973 — the city's tallest structure and fog-wrapped skyline mascot; best seen from Twin Peaks (no public access to the tower itself).
sights.k: Sutro Tower Mount Sutro broadcast tower skyline

sights.address: 826 Valencia St, San Francisco, CA 94110
sights.w: Dave Eggers' tutoring nonprofit hides behind a pirate shop — mermaid tears, spyglasses, skeleton keys and a velvet-draped Fish Theater, with kids writing stories in the back room.
sights.k: 826 Valencia pirate supply store Dave Eggers

sights.address: 2550 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94110
sights.w: Landmark 1916 movie palace (Timothy Pflueger's 1932 Art Deco remodel) revived by Alamo Drafthouse in 2015 — cult films, cocktails delivered to your seat and the restored neon blade sign.
sights.k: New Mission Theater Alamo Drafthouse Art Deco cinema

sights.n: Precita Eyes Mural Arts & Visitors Center
sights.address: 2981 24th St, San Francisco, CA 94110
sights.w: HQ of the muralist collective founded 1977 by Susan & Luis Cervantes — start here for the weekend Mission Trail Mural Walk through Balmy Alley and 24th St.
sights.k: Precita Eyes mural tours visitor center 24th Street

sights.address: Upper Great Highway (along Ocean Beach to Sloat Blvd), San Francisco, CA 94122
sights.w: The car-free Great Highway, reborn in April 2025 as a 2-mile oceanfront park beside Ocean Beach — dune-side promenade, art, a Taraval St lounge with hammocks and a skate park/pump track at Sloat.
sights.k: Sunset Dunes Great Highway car-free park Ocean Beach

sights.address: Grandview Park (Turtle Hill), Golden Gate Heights, San Francisco, CA 94122
sights.w: Locals' 'Turtle Hill' — a short climb of wooden stairs and dune scrub to a 360° view over Golden Gate Park, the ocean, the Marin Headlands and Sutro Tower; pair with the mosaic stairs below.
sights.k: Grandview Park Turtle Hill 360 view Sunset

sights.address: 670 Stanyan St, San Francisco, CA 94117
sights.w: 1925 stadium in Golden Gate Park's southeast corner — the 49ers' and Raiders' first home, now Rec & Park's community stadium and home of Golden City FC pro soccer.
sights.k: Kezar Stadium historic 49ers stadium Golden Gate Park

sights.address: Rincon Center (former Rincon Annex post office lobby), San Francisco, CA 94105
sights.w: Anton Refregier's 27-panel WPA 'History of San Francisco' (1941–48) in the old Rincon Annex post office lobby — once denounced in Congress, now restored and free to see.
sights.k: Rincon Annex Refregier WPA murals post office lobby

sights.address: Rincon Park, The Embarcadero between Howard & Folsom Sts, San Francisco, CA 94105
sights.w: Claes Oldenburg & Coosje van Bruggen's 60-ft bow and arrow (2002) half-buried in Rincon Park's lawn, aimed at the Bay Bridge — where Tony Bennett 'left his heart'.
sights.k: Cupid's Span Oldenburg bow arrow Rincon Park

sights.address: Magic Theatre annex, Fort Mason Center, San Francisco, CA 94123
sights.w: The African Orthodox church that canonised John Coltrane — Sunday-afternoon services are a three-hour jazz-gospel jam built around 'A Love Supreme'; now meeting in the Magic Theatre annex at Fort Mason.
sights.k: St John Coltrane African Orthodox Church A Love Supreme jazz service

sights.address: 1198 Fulton St (at Scott St), San Francisco, CA 94117
sights.w: The 1889 Italianate 'Russian Embassy' on Alamo Square's northwest corner — a tower-topped Victorian with a century of counterculture tenants (Kenneth Anger, the Family Dog); admire from the street (private home).
sights.k: Westerfeld House Alamo Square Victorian Russian Embassy

sights.address: The Panhandle (Golden Gate Park), San Francisco, CA 94117
sights.w: Golden Gate Park's eight-block 'handle' — the eucalyptus-lined promenade where Hammond Hall first tamed the dunes, saved from a freeway by the 1960s revolt and site of the Dead's free shows.
sights.k: Panhandle park Golden Gate Park freeway revolt

sights.address: 330 Ellis St, San Francisco, CA 94102
sights.w: The Tenderloin's radically inclusive Methodist church — the Sunday 11am Celebration is a gospel-choir service that spills onto the street, and Glide's meal program feeds the neighbourhood.
sights.k: Glide Memorial Church Sunday Celebration gospel Tenderloin

sights.address: 859 O'Farrell St, San Francisco, CA 94109
sights.w: SF's oldest nightclub — a gilded 1907 dance hall (once a bordello, per legend) with balconies and frescoed ceilings, still booking intimate shows; just logged its best year in half a century.
sights.k: Great American Music Hall 1907 ornate venue

sights.address: Lafayette Park, Washington St & Gough St, San Francisco, CA 94109
sights.w: Hilltop Pacific Heights park (est. 1867) ringed by mansions — Spreckels Mansion faces it — with views to the Marina, Alcatraz and Twin Peaks; tennis courts, dog lawn, playground.
sights.k: Lafayette Park Pacific Heights hilltop views Spreckels

sights.address: 2645 Gough St (at Union St), San Francisco, CA 94123
sights.w: An 1861 eight-sided house — one of two survivors of the octagon craze — now the Colonial Dames' small museum of colonial & federal decorative arts; a time capsule turned up in its walls. Open a few afternoons a month.
sights.k: McElroy Octagon House museum Cow Hollow 1861

sights.address: Precita Ave between Folsom & Alabama Sts, San Francisco, CA 94110
sights.w: Bernal Heights' flat, sunny three-block green — butterfly garden, playground and a parkside café; birthplace of SF's Carnaval (1979) and home of Precita Eyes' murals nearby.
sights.k: Precita Park Bernal Heights Carnaval birthplace

sights.address: Vermont St between 20th & 22nd Sts (by McKinley Square), San Francisco, CA 94107
sights.w: Potrero Hill's seven hairpins — measurably more crooked than Lombard (sinuosity 1.56 vs 1.2) and tourist-free; climb the stairs to McKinley Square for downtown views.
sights.k: Vermont Street crookedest street Potrero Hill McKinley Square

sights.address: Pier 70, Illinois St (Mariposa St to 22nd St), San Francisco, CA 94107
sights.w: A century of West Coast shipbuilding (Union Iron Works, Bethlehem Steel) on the Dogpatch waterfront — brick machine shops and dry docks, now reviving with the Building 12 market hall.
sights.k: Pier 70 Union Iron Works shipyard Dogpatch Building 12

sights.address: Cypress Lawn Memorial Park, Colma, CA 94014
sights.w: Gateway to Colma, the 'city of the dead' where 1.5 million San Franciscans were reburied — Cypress Lawn's 1892 arboretum grounds, Gilded-Age mausoleums and a columbarium under a stained-glass ceiling.
sights.k: Colma Cypress Lawn necropolis city of the dead cemetery arboretum

sights.address: 1000 Linda Mar Blvd, Pacifica, CA 94044
sights.w: San Mateo County's oldest building — an 1840s ranchero's adobe on the site of a Mission Dolores outpost and an Ohlone village, furnished in period and run by the county historical association.
sights.k: Sanchez Adobe Pacifica historic adobe Mission Dolores outpost

sights.address: 2600 Geneva Ave, Daly City, CA 94014
sights.w: 1941 livestock arena turned rock shrine — the Beatles (1964), the Grateful Dead, Nirvana, JFK's Peace Corps speech — still hosting rodeos, dog shows and gun-and-crafts weekends.
sights.k: Cow Palace Daly City arena Beatles rodeo

sights.address: Lands End Point, below the Coastal Trail, Lands End, San Francisco, CA 94121
sights.w: Eduardo Aguilera's seven-circuit stone labyrinth (2004) on a cliff-top terrace at Lands End Point — Golden Gate Bridge across the strait; repeatedly vandalised and rebuilt by volunteers.
sights.k: Lands End labyrinth stone Chartres Golden Gate view

sights.address: USS San Francisco Memorial, Lands End, San Francisco, CA 94121
sights.w: The shell-holed bridge wings of the heavy cruiser USS San Francisco, aimed toward Guadalcanal — a memorial to the 106 sailors killed in the 1942 Naval Battle of Guadalcanal.
sights.k: USS San Francisco memorial bridge Guadalcanal Lands End

sights.address: 16th Ave between Kirkham St & Lawton St, San Francisco, CA 94122
sights.w: The 148-step mosaic sibling of the Moraga tiled steps (Barr & Crutcher, 2013) — nine themed panels of flowers, insects and critters climbing Golden Gate Heights.
sights.k: Hidden Garden Steps mosaic staircase 16th Avenue Kirkham

sights.n: Golden Gate Park Carousel (Koret Children's Quarter)
sights.address: Koret Children's Quarter, Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, CA 94117
sights.w: The 1914 Herschell-Spillman carousel from the 1939 Expo — 62 hand-carved animals and a German band organ — beside the country's first public children's playground.
sights.k: Golden Gate Park Herschell-Spillman carousel Koret playground

sights.address: 57 Post St, San Francisco, CA 94104
sights.w: 1854 membership library with a spiral marble staircase and the nation's oldest continuously operating chess club; free public tours Wednesdays at noon.
sights.k: Mechanics' Institute library chess room spiral staircase

sights.n: Children's Creativity Museum & LeRoy King Carousel
sights.address: Children's Creativity Museum, Yerba Buena Gardens, San Francisco, CA 94103
sights.w: Hands-on animation, music and media studios for kids 2–12 atop Yerba Buena Gardens, with the jewel-studded 1906 LeRoy King Carousel out front.
sights.k: Children's Creativity Museum LeRoy King Carousel Yerba Buena kids

sights.address: 77 Steuart St, San Francisco, CA 94105
sights.w: Market Street Railway's free storefront museum opposite the Ferry Building — a replica streetcar platform and motorman's controls; the base for the vintage F-line and Muni Heritage Weekend.
sights.k: San Francisco Railway Museum Market Street Railway F-line streetcars
